description: An invented inbox for scripts/ingest-eval: twenty captures of one day, 9 November 2026, in English and German, and what each should leave behind. `words` are regular expressions, ignoring case, that the facts line, the current item or the task title must hold, because a model words its lines its own way. For a fact or a current item, `topic` is null when it belongs above the first topic, a regular expression for the topic's name when it belongs under one, and missing where the filing rules leave room. `no_longer` is a value that must not stand in the facts list any more, and `earlier` what the fact file keeps of it under `## Earlier`. A task says its `due` day, or null for none. One capture writes its day out with its year, one names a weekday and one a day without its year; those two count from the day of the capture, so the expected day is the same on whatever day the eval runs, and the weekday's lies before any such day: a model that counts from the day of the run cannot land on it. A capture without `expected` holds nothing to file. `topics` names the topics a filing may start; the store before has the others.
